intro: We made Upmods Squadro for visual clarity. Strong lines, smart storage—everything has its place and keep your bedroom feeling put-together, even when you’re not.

features.title: Geometry that grounds the space
features.text: The grid-panelled headboard adds a sense of order and rhythm—bringing quiet visual structure to your bedroom’s backdrop.

features.title: A frame that keeps its promise
features.text: Made from engineered wood, the Squadro offers long-term structural strength without losing its calm, modern aesthetic.

features.title: Storage that disappears when you don’t need it
features.text: The smooth lift-up mechanism makes it effortless to access spacious storage underneath—perfect for duvets, winterwear, or your favourite extras. Available in multiple storage options, so you can choose what works best for your home and lifestyle.

features.title: Matte finish, maximum warmth
features.text: The soft wood tone absorbs light just right—creating an atmosphere that’s warm, grounded, and inherently restful.

features.title: Tough against time
features.text: Its PU-coated surface resists scratches, dust, and daily wear—so it looks new, even when life gets messy.

name: Upmods Squadro King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
